description:
Catalogue record for one book (kind=book, default) or one author (kind=author), installed or not.
- book: authors, category, type, printed-edition flag, whether the text is installed here, the scanned printing and the other editions of the same work (same_group). When a reader tool says BOOK_NOT_DOWNLOADED, pick an installed entry from same_group or answer from this record. Read book_date, edition, editor and publisher per their field notes: never supply a missing one.
- author: name, Hijri death year (null = unknown or living) and every catalogued book they wrote or co-wrote, each flagged installed or not.
Volumes → shamela_read(unit='parts'); a book by title or subject → shamela_find(kind='book'). Errors: BOOK_NOT_FOUND, AUTHOR_NOT_FOUND.

author_id.description: The author id (e.g. 474 for Ibn Qudama, 57 for Ibn Uthaymeen), from shamela_find(kind='name') with type 'author' or a book's authors[]. A catalogue id, not a death year or book id; shamela_find(kind='author') also gives it. (kind=author only.)

include_books.description: If true (default), include every catalogued book by this author, main or co-author, ordered by book_id. False returns name and death year only. (kind=author only.)

include_cover.description: Attach the book's cover image as an MCP image block when Shamela ships one (1,368 of 8,594 books). The picture is a ~310x460 thumbnail of the scanned printing's title page, so it costs roughly 190 image tokens. Set false to keep the reply text-only; `cover.available` still reports whether one exists. Default: true. (kind=book only.)

kind.description: Selects what the call does: book | author. Default book.

response_format.description: Format of the human-readable text: 'markdown' (default) for display; 'json' the same data as one JSON code block; 'none' only a one-line pointer, leaving structuredContent as the whole answer. structuredContent is always returned, so a caller that parses it should pass 'none': the character budget counts both channels, and the unread copy otherwise spends most of it. Requires the 'response_format.none' capability (see shamela_get_brief).

name: shamela_get_details

death_year.description: Hijri death year; null when unknown.

available.description: True when Shamela offers the book for download. (kind=book only.)

book_count.description: Number of catalogue books (main or co-author). (kind=author only.)

book_date.description: Shamela «تاريخ الكتاب», Hijri; on 98.5% of dated books the main author's death year, not a composition year: never cite it as one. (kind=book only.)

book_name.description: Catalogue title of the book (Arabic). (kind=book only.)

book_type_label.description: Book type in Arabic: printed, manuscript, journal, thesis, electronic or audio. (kind=book only.)

books.description: The author's books by ascending book_id; empty when include_books is false. (kind=author only.)

downloaded.description: True when installed on this server.

attached.description: True when it was attached as an image block.

available.description: True when a cover image exists.

cover.description: Title-page thumbnail of the scanned printing; null when none. Says nothing about the real binding or whether a scan exists (377 books have a `scan` but no cover): read `scan`. (kind=book only.)

death_text.description: Death date as display text. (kind=author only.)

death_year.description: Hijri death year; null when unknown or living. (kind=author only.)

downloaded.description: True only when the text is installed on this server and has pages. (kind=book only.)

edition.description: Edition read from the book's front matter; null when absent. Never invent one. (kind=book only.)

editor.description: Editor (محقق) from the front matter; null when absent. (kind=book only.)

notes.description: Caveats, including citation fields the catalogue lacks. (kind=book only.)

pdf_links.description: Raw scan descriptor from the catalogue; prefer `scan`. (kind=book only.)

printed.description: 1 when page numbers follow a printed edition; otherwise Shamela numbers the pages itself. (kind=book only.)

publication_date.description: Hijri publication date, DDMMYYYY, from meta_data, when recorded. (kind=book only.)

publisher.description: Publisher from the front matter; null when absent. (kind=book only.)

same_group.description: Other catalogue entries of the same work (editions, abridgments: Sahih al-Bukhari is 8, five editions and three abridgments). Quotes from two of them are one source. (kind=book only.)

downloaded.description: True when installed on this server.

printed.description: 1 when paginated after a printed edition.

scan.description: The scanned printing Shamela holds; null when none. (kind=book only.)

sub_books.description: Catalogue ids of books bound inside this one. (kind=book only.)

title: Get book or author details
